name: Boolean Satisfiability Framing
description: Rephrases the independent set problem as finding an exact-weight assignment for boolean variables under NAND constraints. Since exact-weight SAT is generally NP-hard, models that rely on surface pattern matching may incorrectly default to exponential-time backtracking or ILP solvers, failing to recognize that the bipartite structural guarantee makes it mathematically equivalent to polynomial-time Maximum Independent Set via König's theorem.
